description: Change a provider; 400 with the problems for template errors, bad paths or a path clash.

callback_template_key.description: The webhook template its status callbacks are sent with; null sends none.

check_credentials.description: Off: any credentials are accepted. On: wrong ones get the `unauthorized` answer.

credentials.description: The credentials your app is configured with; a masked secret keeps the stored value.

error_responses.description: The answer for each kind of error.

field_mapping.description: Where each part of a sent message is read from.

host.description:
The provider's API host, used on the provider port to tell apart providers that share
a path; null when not needed.

is_enabled.description: Off providers answer nothing; their paths get SendMock's native 404.

key.description: The provider's key; fixed after creation, so the path's key wins.

message_id_template.description: The provider's id for each message, a template.

name.description: The provider's name, shown on messages and in pickers.

opt_out_auto_replies.description:
SMS: answer STOP, START and HELP with Twilio's default replies, stored as outbound
messages.

opt_out_keywords.description:
SMS: Twilio's Advanced Opt-Out. An inbound STOP (STOPALL, UNSUBSCRIBE, CANCEL, END,
QUIT) blocks later sends to the contact with 21610 until START, YES or UNSTOP. Null
keeps the default: on for Twilio, off for others.

outcome_error_codes.description: SMS only: the provider's error code for each delivery outcome.

provider_key.description: The provider's key, e.g. `twilio`, from its providers list.

status_names.description: The provider's name for each SendMock status.

success_response.description: The answer to a request that passes every check.

validation_rules.description: The checks run on each send, in order.

name: sendmock_sms_provider_update
